courses.name: Reasoning and Logic
courses.description: Introduction to formal reasoning: propositional and predicate logic, proof techniques, and set theory.

courses.name: Computer Organisation
courses.description: Basics of computer architecture (CPU-Memory-IO) with assignments in x86 assembly and learning about how computers represent numbers.

courses.name: Object-oriented Programming
courses.description: Basics of general Java programming in the first half, then a deeper focus on OOP principles in the second half (Inheritance, Interfaces, Composition).

courses.name: Algorithms and Data Structures
courses.description: Basics of common algorithms (sorting, graph traversal, hashing) and data structures (lists, queues, sets, trees).

courses.name: Web and Database Technology
courses.description: Two parts: web technologies (JavaScript, HTML + CSS, Node.js) and databases (SQL, schema design, working with databases, normalization).

courses.name: Calculus
courses.description: Core calculus concepts including limits, differentiation, integration, series, and an introduction to multivariable calculus.

courses.name: Linear Algebra
courses.description: Vectors, matrices, and linear transformations. Covers solving linear systems, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, and geometric interpretations.

courses.name: OOP Project
courses.description: Team project focused on developing a Java app with a backend and a frontend. Our team made a Q&A app for lectures.

courses.name: Information and Data Management
courses.description: How data is physically stored, how databases are designed, and the relational algebra that forms the mathematical foundation of SQL.

courses.name: Computer Networks
courses.description: Covers the layered network model from physical transmission to application protocols, including reliable vs. unreliable transport and routing.

courses.name: Software Quality and Testing
courses.description: All about testing software. From testing techniques (boundary analysis, state-based testing, decision tables) to testing metrics (line, branch, MC/DC). Practical part done in Java with JUnit and Mockito.

courses.name: Probability Theory and Statistics
courses.description: Foundations of probability and statistical inference, including distributions, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis.

courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.description: Covers the main supervised and unsupervised learning techniques including classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and performance evaluation. Practical assignments in Python using scikit-learn.

courses.name: Computer Graphics
courses.description: First half focused on theory (transformations, homogeneous coordinates, projective geometry, shadow mapping, mipmaps, reflections). Second half was implementing a ray tracer with additional features (motion blur, mipmaps, BVH, and more).

courses.name: Big Data Processing
courses.description: Covers distributed data processing paradigms such as map-reduce, stream processing and consensus protocols, with practical assignments in Unix, functional Scala and Spark.

courses.name: Software Engineering Methods
courses.description: Advanced software engineering methodologies with a project focused on building a microservice Java application.

courses.name: Algorithm Design
courses.description: Study of classic algorithm design paradigms: greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, divide and conquer, and network flow, applied to optimization problems.

courses.name: Data Mining
courses.description: Techniques for finding patterns in large datasets, covering locality-sensitive hashing, matrix decomposition, link analysis, and clustering at scale.

courses.name: Concepts of Programming Languages
courses.description: Study of programming language design and implementation: parsing, abstract syntax, interpretation, and lazy evaluation. Built an interpreter for a LISP-like language in Scala.

courses.name: Automata, Computability and Complexity
courses.description: Formal language theory, computability theory, and computational complexity. Covers finite automata, Turing machines, decidability, and NP-completeness.

courses.name: Computational Intelligence
courses.description: Study of nature-inspired algorithms. Implemented a neural network with backpropagation, genetic algorithms, and particle-swarm optimization from scratch.

courses.name: Software Project
courses.description: Internship at a company, building a tool for generating dynamic email replies based on user survey responses using Angular and Node.js.

courses.name: Option Valuation Methods
courses.description: Mathematical models for pricing financial derivatives, including the Black-Scholes formula, the binomial model, Monte Carlo simulation, and hedging strategies.

courses.name: Principles of Asset Trading
courses.description: Study of financial markets and asset pricing theory, covering the CAPM model, corporate finance decisions, dividend payout policy, and debt policy.

courses.name: Introduction to Mathematical Finance
courses.description: Mathematical foundations of financial modeling, including stochastic calculus, Brownian motion, and Itô's lemma, applied to derivative pricing.

courses.name: Time Series
courses.description: Statistical methods for analyzing time-dependent data, including stationarity, ARIMA models, autocorrelation, and forecasting.

courses.name: Data Science for Finance
courses.description: Application of data science techniques to financial datasets, covering data cleaning, regression, tree-based methods, and neural networks.

courses.name: Risk Management
courses.description: Covers risk measurement and management in financial institutions, including regulatory frameworks, risk evaluation methods, and interest rate risk.

courses.name: Functional Programming
courses.description: Introduction to functional programming paradigms and type theory using Haskell and Agda, covering monads, type classes, and dependent types.

courses.name: Algorithms for NP-Hard Problems
courses.description: Techniques for solving and approximating NP-hard optimization problems in practice, including SAT solving, heuristics, and simulation-based methods.

courses.name: Bachelor's Thesis
courses.description: Solving job scheduling with one common and multiple secondary resources problem using a SAT solver.

courses.name: Compiler Construction
courses.description: Design and implementation of a compiler from scratch, covering lexical analysis, parsing, semantic analysis, intermediate representation, and code generation.

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence Techniques
courses.description: Covers probabilistic and decision-theoretic AI methods, including Bayesian networks, Markov decision processes, reinforcement learning, and game theory.

courses.name: Advanced Algorithms
courses.description: Advanced algorithm design and analysis covering linear programming, approximation algorithms, network flow, and advanced search data structures.

courses.name: Distributed Algorithms
courses.description: Covers fundamental distributed algorithms including broadcast protocols, termination detection, consensus, and network overlay structures. Labwork involved implementing different broadcast variants.

courses.name: Machine Learning 1
courses.description: Covers foundational machine learning techniques including linear and nonlinear regression, clustering, support vector machines, and feature dimensionality reduction.

courses.name: Software Verification
courses.description: Formal verification of software correctness using the Coq proof assistant. Covers type theory, inductive propositions, and polymorphism. Implemented and verified a SAT solver proven to be complete and sound.

courses.name: Software Architecture
courses.description: Study of software architecture design, including architectural patterns, quality attributes, and architectural decision-making for large-scale systems.

courses.name: Algorithms for Intelligent Decision Making
courses.description: Algorithms for reasoning and decision-making under uncertainty, covering Markov decision processes, planning, and search-based optimization techniques.

courses.name: Analysis of Concurrent and Distributed Programs
courses.description: Formal analysis of concurrent and distributed systems for correctness properties such as sequential consistency and linearizability. Project involved analyzing Saft, a Raft implementation in Scala, where a bug was found in response term handling.

courses.name: Evolutionary Algorithms
courses.description: Study of population-based and evolutionary optimization algorithms, including genetic algorithms, evolutionary strategies, and selection and recombination operators.

courses.name: Intelligent Decision Making Project
courses.description: Worked on a project for utilizing decision diagrams as a more compact and interpretable alternative to decision trees.

courses.name: Language-Based Software Security
courses.description: Security analysis of programs using formal language and type theory. Covers taint analysis, bound analysis, type-based security enforcement, and abstract interpretation.

courses.name: Data Management and Engineering
courses.description: Covers the full data engineering pipeline including data cleaning, storage, mining, and visualization, with hands-on assignments using modern data management tools.

courses.name: Security and Cryptography
courses.description: Covers classical and modern cryptographic systems including stream ciphers, block ciphers, hash functions, RSA, and zero-knowledge proofs, grounded in number theory.

courses.name: Blockchain Engineering
courses.description: Practical blockchain engineering using Ethereum smart contracts. Extended TU Delft's decentralized music-sharing Android app with smart contract-based donation functionality using the TrustChain framework.

courses.name: Master's Thesis
courses.description: Implemented a blockchain-independent model for continuous transaction execution and a genetic-based ordering heuristic. Achieved 15% increase in validator revenue and 2× faster congestion clearance.
